hypothesis: Reward-induced memory divergence changes future action decisions under a fixed held-out browser observation.

primary_metrics.paired_action_signature_divergence_rate: aligned-rollout fraction where success-memory and failure-memory conditions choose different first structured action signatures
primary_metrics.modal_action_signature_difference_rate: future-task fraction whose modal first action differs between success-memory and failure-memory conditions
primary_metrics.memory_condition_shift_from_no_memory: future-task fraction where either memory condition changes the modal first action relative to no-memory

action_signature: first action name; click actions also include the fixed interactive-element index

falsifier.stop_second_link_if: all complete aligned success-memory versus failure-memory rollouts have identical action signatures across all four held-out future observations

experiment_debt_after_f1: execute paired policies through terminal environment outcomes
measure success variance across controlled reward-corruption rates
transport_note: Scientific design unchanged; R2 disables reasoning output after R1 support failure consumed the full output budget without assistant text.
targeted_repair_role: Fresh distributional replication after deterministic-control inconclusive result; all four frozen held-out states retained.

deterministic_control.primary_support_rule: A stable condition effect requires at least one future state where all three success-memory actions agree, all three failure-memory actions agree, and the two stable signatures differ.
deterministic_control.inconclusive_rule: Within-condition disagreement at temperature 0 prevents deterministic attribution and triggers a larger fresh distributional replication.

distributional_gate.primary_statistic: mean per-state empirical total-variation distance between success-label-memory and failure-label-memory first-action distributions
distributional_gate.permutation_scheme: Within each future state, pool the 16 memory-conditioned actions and randomly assign 8 to each label; repeat independently across all four states.
